questions.stem: The curve remaining above normal during the labeled hormone infusion indicates reduced proximal phosphate reabsorption. Which molecular event best explains it?

options.text: NHERF-1 recruits NaPi-IIa to the apical membrane after PTH stimulation
PKC phosphorylation of NHERF-1 promotes NaPi-IIa dissociation and endocytosis
PTH activates basolateral Na-K-ATPase to increase phosphate uptake
PTH inserts additional NaPi-IIc transporters into the brush border

codexExplanation.explanationZh: PTH 在 proximal tubule 經 PKC phosphorylate NHERF-1，使 NHERF-1 與 NaPi-IIa complex 解離，NaPi-IIa 隨後 internalization，因而降低 phosphate reabsorption、增加 phosphaturia。圖中的 PTH curve 是現象資料，tested decision 是其 transporter-trafficking mechanism。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；NHERF-1在 basal state穩定 apical NaPi-IIa，但 PTH使此 complex解離。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；這是 PTH降低 proximal phosphate reabsorption的直接 trafficking mechanism。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；Na-K-ATPase提供 sodium gradient，但不是 PTH造成 phosphaturia的特異步驟。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；PTH使 NaPi-IIa/IIc apical abundance下降，而非增加 insertion。

authorityEvidence.source: 07. The Regulation of Calcium, Magnesium, and Phosphate Excretion by the Kidney.pdf
authorityEvidence.note_zh: NHERF-1保留 NaPi-IIa於 apical surface；PTH/PKC促進 complex dissociation與 internalization。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 由台大考訓的 NHERF-1重點 adapted；圖像只採 Brenner 12e Fig.7.9的已裁切asset作 visual source，答案 authority完全來自 repo-local Brenner 11e Ch.7。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source provided answer (B) aligns perfectly with both NotebookLM responses (B). Both responses confirm that PKC phosphorylation of NHERF-1 induces NaPi-IIa dissociation and endocytosis in proximal tubule cells under PTH infusion.

questions.stem: Which statement correctly compares renin with angiotensin-converting enzyme?

options.text: Both enzymes have angiotensinogen as their only known substrate
Renin inactivates bradykinin, whereas ACE cleaves angiotensinogen
Renin has one known substrate, whereas ACE also inactivates bradykinin
ACE is substrate-specific, whereas renin degrades multiple natriuretic peptides

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Renin 是高度 substrate-specific 的 protease，唯一已知 substrate 是 angiotensinogen，切出 angiotensin I。ACE則沒有 single-substrate specificity，除生成 angiotensin II外，也會 inactivate bradykinin。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；ACE並非只有 angiotensinogen一個 substrate，而且 ACE不直接以 angiotensinogen為主要 substrate。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；bradykinin inactivation是 ACE作用；renin cleaves angiotensinogen。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；同時符合兩種 enzyme的 substrate profile。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；描述顛倒，natriuretic peptide degradation主要涉及 neprilysin。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: 直接支持 renin single known substrate及 ACE broad specificity/bradykinin inactivation。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 台大考訓直接要求比較 renin、ACE與 neprilysin substrate specificity；無版本衝突。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (C) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (C). Renin specifically cleaves angiotensinogen (single substrate), whereas ACE cleaves angiotensin I and inactivates bradykinin.

questions.stem: How does aldosterone-induced SGK1 most directly increase apical ENaC abundance in principal cells?

options.text: It directly opens ROMK channels
It activates Nedd4-2-mediated ENaC ubiquitination
It internalizes ENaC through clathrin-coated vesicles
It phosphorylates Nedd4-2 and reduces its binding to ENaC

codexExplanation.explanationZh: SGK1 phosphorylates Nedd4-2，降低 Nedd4-2與 ENaC PY domains結合，減少 ENaC ubiquitination/endocytosis並延長 apical residence。增加的 ENaC activity再間接提高 K secretion driving force；aldosterone並不直接活化 ROMK。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；ROMK activity並非 aldosterone/SGK1的直接主要 target。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；SGK1抑制而不是增強 Nedd4-2對 ENaC的作用。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；該機轉會降低 surface ENaC。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確；Nedd4-2 phosphorylation造成 ENaC surface retention。

authorityEvidence.source: 12. Aldosterone and Mineralocorticoid Receptors-Renal and Extrarenal Roles.pdf
authorityEvidence.note_zh: SGK1 phosphorylates Nedd4-2、延長 ENaC apical residence；ROMK不被 aldosterone直接增加 activity。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 台大重點特別提醒 potassium effect不是直接調控 ROMK；題目鎖定 SGK1–Nedd4-2–ENaC層級，避免與 A011重複。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (D) matches both NotebookLM responses (D). Aldosterone-induced SGK1 phosphorylates Nedd4-2, preventing its binding and ubiquitination of ENaC, thereby increasing apical ENaC abundance.

questions.stem: Which interpretation of cystatin C is correct?

options.text: Serum cystatin C reflects filtration, whereas urinary cystatin C suggests proximal tubular injury
Serum cystatin C specifically identifies distal tubular injury
Urinary cystatin C is normally abundant because proximal tubules secrete it
Urinary cystatin C exclusively indicates glomerular podocyte injury

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Cystatin C由 glomerulus自由 filtration，之後幾乎完全由 proximal tubular cells uptake並 catabolize，因此 serum concentration可反映 filtration，而正常 urine含量極低；proximal reabsorptive injury會使 urinary cystatin C上升。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；specimen不同代表的 biologic process不同。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；serum cystatin C是 filtration marker，不是 distal-tubule-specific injury marker。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；正常 proximal tubule是 uptake/catabolism，不是 secretion。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；urinary cystatin C主要反映 proximal tubular handling failure，並非 exclusive podocyte marker。

authorityEvidence.source: 27. Biomarkers in Acute and Chronic Kidney Diseases.pdf
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 說明 filtration、proximal catabolism及 urinary increase。

authorityEvidence.source: 29. Prevention and Management of Acute Kidney Injury.pdf
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 再次區分 serum與urinary cystatin C用途。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 保留台大「serum與urine意義不同」的交換重點；避免宣稱 cystatin C完全不受 non-GFR determinants影響。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (A) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (A). Serum cystatin C is freely filtered and reflects GFR, while urinary cystatin C is normally reabsorbed by proximal tubules and its presence in urine indicates proximal tubular damage.

questions.stem: A patient with diarrhea has normal-anion-gap acidosis, urine pH 6.2, and no advanced CKD. Which test best determines whether renal ammonium excretion is appropriately increased?

options.text: Serum osmolal gap
Fractional excretion of sodium
Urine osmolal gap
Urine protein-to-creatinine ratio

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Diarrhea造成 chronic metabolic acidosis與 hypokalemia時，可有大量 NH4+ excretion並使 urine pH不一定低，故 urine pH 6.2不能單獨證明 RTA。Urine osmolal gap可較可靠地間接估計 urinary NH4+。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；serum osmolal gap用於偵測 unmeasured osmoles，不估 urinary NH4+。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；FENa評估 sodium handling，不是 ammonium surrogate。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；measured與calculated urine osmolality差值可估 NH4+ salts。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；proteinuria不回答 renal acid excretion。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: diarrhea可有較高 urine pH；UOG較可靠估計 urinary NH4+。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 題幹排除 advanced CKD並提供 diarrhea背景，以避免低 NH4+的另一合理原因；不以 urine pH單獨診斷 RTA。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (C) matches both NotebookLM responses (C). Urine osmolal gap accurately estimates urinary ammonium concentration without being confounded by elevated urine pH (> 6.0) or unmeasured anions.

questions.stem: A normotensive patient has persistent hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and repeatedly high urine chloride without vomiting or diuretic exposure. Which etiologic class is most likely?

options.text: Bartter or Gitelman syndrome
Remote vomiting with chloride depletion
Post-hypercapnic alkalosis with chloride depletion
Low intestinal DRA activity with fecal chloride loss

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Metabolic alkalosis合併 persistently high urine chloride且沒有 hypertension，在排除 active diuretic use後支持 renal salt-wasting tubulopathy，如 Bartter或 Gitelman syndrome。Vomiting、post-hypercapnia與 low-GI-DRA通常是 chloride-responsive、urine chloride低的分支。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；符合 normotensive high-urine-chloride alkalosis。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；remote vomiting通常呈低 urine chloride。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；post-hypercapnic alkalosis常屬 chloride-responsive低 urine chloride。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；low DRA造成 fecal chloride loss，通常低 urine chloride，且 A004已測其 mechanism。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: normotensive high urine chloride在排除 diuretic/vomiting後提示 Bartter/Gitelman。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 由亞東 flowchart adapted；題幹明示 repeated value並排除 vomiting/diuretics，避免 single urine chloride造成多解。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (A) matches both NotebookLM responses (A). A normotensive patient with persistent hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and persistently high urine chloride without diuretic exposure or vomiting represents a salt-losing tubulopathy (Bartter or Gitelman syndrome).

questions.stem: Which effect best distinguishes MEPE from FGF23 and sFRP-4 in experimental phosphate wasting?

options.text: MEPE increases proximal phosphate reabsorption
MEPE lowers phosphate by suppressing intestinal phosphate absorption rather than renal reabsorption
MEPE directly inhibits renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase
MEPE lowers phosphate without suppressing the expected rise in 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D

codexExplanation.explanationZh: MEPE會降低 proximal phosphate reabsorption並造成 hypophosphatemia，但不重現 tumor-induced osteomalacia的 vitamin D defect；1,25(OH)2D會因低血磷而上升。FGF23與 sFRP-4則可抑制 renal 1α-hydroxylase。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；MEPE降低而非增加renal phosphate reabsorption。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；MEPE雖也可直接降低intestinal phosphate absorption，但此選項以rather than排除renal mechanism；Brenner明確顯示MEPE同時降低proximal renal phosphate reabsorption並造成phosphaturia。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；直接抑制 1α-hydroxylase是 FGF23/sFRP-4對比重點，並非MEPE作用。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確；這是 MEPE與另外兩者的關鍵差異。

authorityEvidence.source: 07. The Regulation of Calcium, Magnesium, and Phosphate Excretion by the Kidney.pdf
authorityEvidence.note_zh: MEPE造成 phosphaturia但不抑制低磷所誘發的 1,25(OH)2D上升。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 此題是 source-locked experimental physiology，不外推成臨床 treatment recommendation。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (D) matches both NotebookLM responses (D). Unlike FGF23 and sFRP-4 which suppress renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase, MEPE lowers serum phosphate while preserving the physiological compensatory increase in 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D.

questions.stem: A septic adult without traumatic brain injury requires intravascular volume expansion. According to the KDIGO 2026 public-review draft, which fluid is preferred to reduce AKI risk?

options.text: Buffered crystalloid
0.9% saline
Hydroxyethyl starch
Hyperoncotic albumin

codexExplanation.explanationZh: KDIGO 2026 public-review draft Recommendation 3.1.2建議：在沒有 traumatic brain injury時，對有 AKI/AKD或其風險者進行 volume expansion，使用 buffered crystalloids而非 0.9% saline。此處不宣稱 mortality benefit。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；符合 draft Recommendation 3.1.2。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；在指定條件下 draft偏好 buffered crystalloid。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；initial volume expansion應用 crystalloids而非 starch colloid。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；沒有提供需 albumin的特殊適應症，且 draft initial strategy優先 crystalloids。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: crystalloid優於 colloid；無 TBI時 buffered crystalloid優於 0.9% saline。
balanced crystalloids may reduce AKI risk，不支持 mortality宣稱。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: Focus來源以較保守語氣稱 balanced crystalloids may reduce AKI；current KDIGO 2026 public-review draft給出 1B recommendation，但仍必須標示 draft身分。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (A) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (A). According to KDIGO 2026 Recommendation 3.1.2, buffered crystalloids are preferred over 0.9% saline for intravascular volume expansion in non-TBI septic adults to prevent hyperchloremic renal vasoconstriction and reduce AKI risk.

questions.stem: A volume-overloaded patient with AKI needs an urgent water-soluble antibiotic. Which pharmacokinetic change most directly affects the loading dose?

options.text: Reduced tubular secretion always requires a smaller loading dose
Expanded volume of distribution may require a larger loading dose
Reduced GFR eliminates the need for a loading dose
Dialyzer flux determines the predialysis loading dose in every patient

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Critical illness與 volume overload會擴大 water-soluble drug的 volume of distribution，因此 adequate early concentration可能需要較大的 loading dose。Reduced kidney clearance與 RRT主要影響 maintenance interval/dose及 postdialysis supplementation，不能只用 eGFR決定 loading dose。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；reduced clearance主要影響 maintenance exposure，不必然縮小 loading dose。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；loading dose主要取決於 volume of distribution與 target concentration。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；urgent therapeutic concentration仍需要 loading dose。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；dialyzer flux影響 extracorporeal clearance，但不是每位病人 initial loading dose的唯一決定因子。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: volume overload擴大 Vd可能需較高 loading dose；clearance與 RRT影響後續 dosing。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 只考 direction與 pharmacokinetic parameter，不推導任何 named antibiotic的精確 dose。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (B) matches both NotebookLM responses (B). Loading dose is determined by target Cmax and volume of distribution (Vd). Volume overload expands the extracellular fluid space, increasing Vd for hydrophilic antibiotics and requiring a larger loading dose.

questions.stem: A volume-depleted patient has acute lithium poisoning. Which statement about enhancing renal elimination is most accurate?

options.text: Forced diuresis is routinely recommended for all poisonings
Loop diuretics should create urine output above 5 mL/kg/h
Fluid administration is contraindicated because lithium is renally cleared
Correcting volume depletion can reduce tubular lithium reabsorption, but forced diuresis is not recommended

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Forced diuresis沒有證實 benefit，且可造成 pulmonary/cerebral edema與 electrolyte disturbances，所以不建議。Lithium在 volume contraction時 tubular reabsorption增加；若沒有 fluid contraindication，矯正 volume depletion仍是合理 supportive care，但不能取代 severe toxicity所需 ECTR。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；forced diuresis目前不建議。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；刻意追求 supraphysiologic urine output沒有 benefit且可能有害。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；適當 volume repletion可降低 volume-contraction相關 lithium reabsorption。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確；清楚區分 volume correction與 forced diuresis。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: forced diuresis無 benefit及其 harm；lithium volume repletion例外。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 題幹限定 volume depletion；若有 pulmonary edema、oliguria或 severe toxicity，處置會改變。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (D) matches both NotebookLM responses (D). Volume repletion with isotonic saline restores effective circulating volume, reducing compensatory proximal tubular lithium reabsorption, whereas forced diuresis is not recommended due to high risk of pulmonary/cerebral edema and electrolyte complications.

questions.stem: During bicarbonate therapy for salicylate poisoning in a stable patient without a dialysis indication, urine pH remains acidic and serum potassium is 2.8 mEq/L. What is the most important corrective step?

options.text: Add acetazolamide
Acidify the urine
Replete potassium while continuing monitored alkalinization
Stop monitoring serum pH

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Hypokalemia時 collecting tubule會以 H+ secretion交換 K+ reabsorption，使 urine難以 alkalinize。補充 potassium是達到 urine ion trapping的必要步驟，同時持續監測 urine pH、serum pH與 volume status。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；acetazolamide可能造成 systemic acidosis，增加 salicylate tissue distribution。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；salicylate是 weak acid，urine alkalinization才能增加 ion trapping與 elimination。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；未矯正 hypokalemia會阻礙 alkaline urine形成。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；必須監測 serum pH以避免 severe alkalemia。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: hypokalemia阻礙 urine alkalinization；potassium應積極矯正。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: Stem已明示病人stable且沒有dialysis indication；若後續出現severe kidney failure、pulmonary edema、cerebral edema或其他ECTR trigger，management priority必須重新評估。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer is C. Both NLM responses (Index 0 & Index 1) unanimously select C with complete rationale based on salicylate ion trapping and hypokalemia-induced paradoxical aciduria.

questions.stem: Which patient is the best candidate for multiple-dose activated charcoal?

options.text: Carbamazepine overdose with a protected airway and normal bowel function
Phenobarbital overdose with unprotected airway and declining consciousness
Theophylline overdose with mechanical ileus
Quinine overdose with persistent uncontrolled vomiting

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Carbamazepine是 MDAC典型適應 poison之一；protected airway與正常 bowel function滿足安全前提。Unprotected airway、ileus/obstruction及 persistent uncontrolled vomiting都是重要 contraindications。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；poison適合且沒有列出的 GI/airway contraindication。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；phenobarbital可適用 MDAC，但 unprotected airway使 aspiration risk不可接受。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；theophylline可適用，但 mechanical ileus是 contraindication。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；quinine可適用，但 persistent vomiting是 contraindication。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: 直接支持 carbamazepine等適應 poison與 airway/GI contraindications。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 避免把 MDAC適應症與 single-dose charcoal timing混用；本題只比較同層的 poison適用性與 safety prerequisites。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer is A. Both NLM responses (Index 0 & Index 1) select A, providing comprehensive rationale on indications (carbamazepine) and contraindication exclusions (protected airway, normal bowel function).

questions.stem: An older woman with CKD develops AKI, hyperphosphatemia, and hypocalcemia two weeks after oral sodium-phosphate bowel preparation. Which lesion is most likely?

options.text: Birefringent calcium oxalate crystals in tubules
Monosodium urate crystals in collecting ducts
Nonpolarizable calcium phosphate deposits with tubular injury
Subepithelial immune-complex deposits along the glomerular basement membrane

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Oral sodium-phosphate bowel preparation可在 CKD、older age、female sex與 volume contraction等 susceptible conditions造成 acute phosphate nephropathy。Transient phosphate load導致 intratubular calcium-phosphate precipitation、obstruction及 direct tubular injury；crystals呈 bluish-purple且 nonpolarizable。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；birefringent calcium oxalate提示 oxalate nephropathy，A028已測該類型。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；urate nephropathy需要不同 exposure或 tumor-lysis context。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；exposure、electrolytes、timing與 pathology均吻合 acute phosphate nephropathy。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；這是 glomerular immune-deposit pattern，不能解釋 sodium-phosphate exposure。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: 說明 pathogenesis、risk factors與 nonpolarizable calcium-phosphate deposits。

authorityEvidence.source: 18. Disorders of Calcium, Magnesium, and Phosphate Balance.pdf
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 描述 colonoscopy後 presentation、biopsy與不完全 recovery。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 北榮來源列 PTH上升為伴隨 finding，但本題不把 PTH視為必要診斷條件；tested decision鎖定 exposure與 deposit morphology。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer is C. Both NLM responses (Index 0 & Index 1) select C based on acute phosphate nephropathy pathophysiology and negative birefringence (nonpolarizable) of calcium phosphate deposits.

questions.stem: A resuscitated patient has stage 3 AKI and rising azotemia but no refractory hyperkalemia, severe acidemia, pulmonary edema, uremic complication, or dialyzable intoxication. Which strategy reasonably avoids unnecessary kidney replacement therapy while the patient is closely monitored?

options.text: Start kidney replacement therapy immediately because stage 3 AKI alone is sufficient
Start kidney replacement therapy immediately because azotemia is rising
Continue close monitoring and defer kidney replacement therapy unless a clear indication develops
Start continuous kidney replacement therapy solely because it is safer than observation

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Optimal timing仍有爭議。在沒有emergent indication時，密切監測並延後KRT是合理策略，因為部分severe AKI病人可在未接受KRT下恢復；若出現overt complication則啟動KRT。這不表示early KRT在所有族群均已證實無效。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤。Stage 3 AKI 表示嚴重度，但在無 emergency indication 時不是單獨啟動 KRT 的充分條件。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤。Azotemia 趨勢需整體判讀；不可只以孤立或上升中的 nitrogenous waste 數值決定立即 KRT。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確。無明確 emergency indication 時，可密切監測並避免不必要的 preemptive KRT。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤。CRRT 是 modality 選擇；它不會憑自身安全性創造 initiation indication。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: 明確區分 hyperkalemia、refractory pulmonary congestion、dialyzable intoxication等indications，以及無emergency時early strategy未改善mortality。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 依交換資料的 critical-care key point 新寫 clinical framing；刻意排除會改變答案的 emergent indications，並避免固定 BUN threshold。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer is C. Both NLM responses (Index 0 & Index 1) select C, citing KDIGO 2026 guidelines and landmark trials (AKIKI, STARRT-AKI) recommending deferred KRT timing strategy.

questions.stem: Which dialysis-water contaminant is correctly paired with its characteristic toxicity?

options.text: Aluminum — acute intradialytic hemolysis
Chloramine — chronic osteomalacia
Aluminum — dialysis-associated encephalopathy
Chloramine — microcytic anemia from chronic accumulation

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Chronic aluminum accumulation 可造成 osteomalacia、microcytic anemia 與 dialysis-associated encephalopathy。Chloramine 經 dialysate 直接暴露血液則典型造成 acute hemolysis，並可伴 methemoglobinemia。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤。Acute intradialytic hemolysis較符合 chloramine exposure；aluminum主要是慢性累積毒性。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤。Chronic osteomalacia是 aluminum toxicity的典型表現。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確。Dialysis-associated encephalopathy是 chronic aluminum accumulation的經典毒性。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤。Microcytic anemia可見於 aluminum accumulation，而非chloramine的慢性累積。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: 支持 aluminum 的 osteomalacia、microcytic anemia、encephalopathy，以及 chloramine 的 acute hemolysis/methemoglobinemia。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 交換資料要求比較 aluminum 與 chloramine toxicity；本題只考有 Brenner 直接支持的 phenotype pairing，不考污染物濃度門檻。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer is C. Both NLM responses (Index 0 & Index 1) select C, identifying aluminum toxicity with dialysis dementia / encephalopathy.

questions.stem: A patient with active gastrointestinal bleeding requires intermittent hemodialysis for refractory hyperkalemia. Which anticoagulation strategy is most appropriate for this session?

options.text: Routine full-dose systemic unfractionated heparin
Anticoagulation-free dialysis with high blood flow and frequent saline flushes
Routine low-molecular-weight heparin without dose reduction
Warfarin loading before dialysis

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Active bleeding 是 intermittent HD 避免 systemic anticoagulation 的明確情境。Anticoagulation-free HD 可利用 high blood flow、frequent saline flushes 與適當 circuit management 降低 clotting；若中心具備條件，也可考慮 regional strategy。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤。Active GI bleeding時 routine full-dose systemic heparin會增加出血風險。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確。此情境適合 anticoagulation-free IHD，並以 high blood flow及saline flush維持circuit。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤。Routine LMWH仍是systemic anticoagulation，並未處理 active bleeding risk。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤。Warfarin不適合用來維持本次dialysis circuit，且會加重出血風險。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: Active bleeding支持no anticoagulation或regional anticoagulation；anticoagulation-free HD以saline flush/high blood flow降低clotting。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 以 active bleeding 取代易受中心差異影響的術後時間窗；題目限定 intermittent HD，避免與 A032 的 CRRT citrate monitoring重疊。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer is B. Both NLM responses (Index 0 & Index 1) select B, explaining that active bleeding mandates anticoagulation-free HD using high blood flow and saline flushes.

No numeric target for any patient aged 50 years or older

It establishes unilateral aldosterone production.
It excludes autonomous aldosterone secretion.
It replaces all confirmatory testing and subtype evaluation.

Exclusion of primary aldosteronism

questions.stem: A hemodialysis patient at 24 weeks of pregnancy has stable fetal growth and no pulmonary edema. How should her prescribed dry weight generally change?

Decrease it weekly to prevent any gestational weight gain
Increase it immediately by 5 kg without reassessment
Increase gradually, up to about 0.5 kg per week, while avoiding hypovolemia

A remote history of vascular-access thrombosis

questions.stem: Which podocyte-derived ligand and glomerular-endothelial receptor pairing is essential for maintaining the glomerular filtration barrier?

optionAnalysisZh.C: Complement evaluation 重要但不應取代更急迫的 ADAMTS13 與 aPLA 分流。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確；這是 KDIGO Figure 13 的第一層分流。

authorityEvidence.locator: original PDF p.S48, Figure 13; pp.S48-S49, Section 10.3.1
authorityEvidence.note_zh: LN-TMA 先驗 ADAMTS13 activity/antibodies 與 aPLA，再按 TTP、APS、complement-mediated/other branch 治療。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 已目視回讀 KDIGO 2024 LN original PDF p.S48 Figure 13。Image 只證明 TMA morphology，不指定 etiology。若成人 PLASMIC score 為 moderate/high risk，等待 ADAMTS13 時需考慮先啟動 PEX/glucocorticoid；本題不測該後續分支。

questions.reconciliationNotes: All sources agree on option D (ADAMTS13 activity/inhibitor and antiphospholipid antibodies).

questions.stem:
An older man with a pelvic mass undergoes the displayed MR urogram. After bladder decompression, urine output is 600 mL/hour, weight is falling, blood pressure and serum sodium are stable, urine is isosthenuric, glucose is normal, and he received no diuretic.

Which feature most strongly explains his risk of clinically significant post-obstructive diuresis?

options.text: The obstruction was unilateral with a normal contralateral kidney
The urine was maximally concentrated immediately after decompression
Both functioning kidneys were obstructed
He had isolated lower urinary tract symptoms without upper tract obstruction

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Clinically significant post-obstructive diuresis 最常見於 bilateral obstruction 或 solitary functioning kidney obstruction，因解除前累積的 salt/water/urea 加上 obstruction 後持續 tubular concentrating 與 reabsorptive defects。單側阻塞且另一腎正常時通常不會有同等程度的全身性 diuresis。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正常對側腎可持續調節 volume/solute，單側阻塞較少造成顯著 POD。
optionAnalysisZh.B: POD 常伴 impaired concentrating ability，不是 maximally concentrated urine。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；bilateral obstruction 是 clinically significant POD 的典型高風險分布。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 沒有 upper tract obstruction 就缺乏本題 post-obstructive tubular/solute mechanism。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: POD tubular physiology；顯著病例通常為 bilateral 或 solitary-kidney obstruction。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: Image 用來建立 bilateral obstruction；case 排除 diuretic 與 hyperglycemic osmotic diuresis。POD 並非只由單一 urine-output cutoff 定義。

questions.reconciliationNotes: All sources agree on option C (Both functioning kidneys were obstructed).

questions.stem:
An older man with a pelvic mass undergoes the displayed MR urogram. After bladder decompression, urine output is 600 mL/hour, weight is falling, blood pressure and serum sodium are stable, urine is isosthenuric, glucose is normal, and he received no diuretic.

What is the best initial fluid strategy while this diuresis continues?

options.text: Replace every milliliter of urine with isotonic saline indefinitely
Give 0.45% saline somewhat slower than urine output, with frequent reassessment
Withhold all fluid until urine output falls below 100 mL/hour
Give desmopressin routinely to stop the diuresis

codexExplanation.explanationZh: 目前無 shock、serum sodium 穩定且 urine isosthenuric，可用 0.45% saline 以略慢於尿量的速度開始 replacement，並頻繁監測 volume status、urine、electrolytes 與 osmolality。完全逐毫升補回可能延長 diuresis；完全禁水則可能造成 hypovolemia。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 固定 100% replacement 會阻礙 negative balance，可能延長 POD。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；這是初始、可反覆調整的 cautious replacement strategy。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 完全不補液可能造成 severe volume/electrolyte depletion。
optionAnalysisZh.D: POD 不是 routine desmopressin indication，且應先按 volume/solute composition 管理。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: 0.45% saline somewhat slower than urine output，並密切監測；過度 replacement 可延長 diuresis。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 『Somewhat slower』不是固定百分比。若發生 shock/severe depletion、明顯 dysnatremia 或 urine composition 改變，fluid type/rate 必須相應調整。

questions.reconciliationNotes: All sources agree on option B (Give 0.45% saline somewhat slower than urine output, with frequent reassessment).

questions.stem: A patient with retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy and rising creatinine had a negative renal ultrasound. The displayed CT later shows delayed enhancement and hydronephrosis. Which principle best explains the discrepancy?

options.text: Ultrasound reliably excludes obstruction when hydronephrosis is absent
Extrinsic ureteral encasement can cause a false-negative ultrasound
Delayed nephrograms establish renal artery stenosis rather than obstruction
Retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy cannot obstruct the ureters

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Early obstruction、dehydration、retroperitoneal fibrosis 或 tumor encasement 可使 ultrasound 偽陰性。高 pretest probability 且懷疑 extrinsic process 時，cross-sectional CT 能顯示 delayed enhancement、hydronephrosis 與 retroperitoneal cause，不能因一次 negative ultrasound 排除阻塞。

optionAnalysisZh.A: Early obstruction、dehydration、retroperitoneal fibrosis 或 tumor encasement 都可能使 ultrasound 偽陰性。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；extrinsic ureteral encasement 可在 ultrasound 未見典型 hydronephrosis 時仍造成 obstruction。
optionAnalysisZh.C: Delayed nephrogram 配合 hydronephrosis 與 retroperitoneal process 支持 obstructive，而非單獨證明 renovascular disease。
optionAnalysisZh.D: Retroperitoneal fibrosis、tumor 或 lymphadenopathy 都可能包繞並壓迫 ureters。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: Retroperitoneal process 可致 US false-negative；CT 適合顯示 extrinsic causes。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 不以單一 renal resistive-index cutoff 作答。若 pregnancy、contrast limitation、hemodynamic instability 或 infected obstruction，影像與緊急處置路徑會不同。

questions.reconciliationNotes: All sources agree on option B (Extrinsic ureteral encasement can cause a false-negative ultrasound).

questions.stem: A recurrent stone former with enteric hyperoxaluria and no hypercalcemia has the displayed urinary crystals. Which dietary advice is most appropriate?

options.text: Consume 1000-1200 mg of calcium daily with meals
Restrict dietary calcium below 400 mg daily
Take high-dose vitamin C with each meal
Take calcium supplements only at bedtime away from food

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Calcium oxalate stone formers generally應維持 normal dietary calcium，並與 meals 同時攝取，使 calcium 在腸道結合 oxalate、降低 oxalate absorption 與 urinary oxalate。低 calcium diet 反而增加 oxalate bioavailability；high-dose vitamin C 也可增加 oxalate burden。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；normal calcium with meals 對 enteric hyperoxaluria 尤其有利。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 過度限鈣減少 intestinal oxalate binding，可能增加 CaOx stone risk。
optionAnalysisZh.C: High-dose vitamin C 可代謝為 oxalate，增加 urinary oxalate。
optionAnalysisZh.D: Calcium 離開 meals 服用無法有效結合食物中的 oxalate。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: 1000-1200 mg/day calcium with meals binds intestinal oxalate；low-calcium diet 與 vitamin C 的風險。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 本題不把 unrestricted calcium supplements 等同 normal dietary calcium。Current source image 解析度僅 371x248，正式 promotion 前須通過 blocking mobile readability QA。

questions.reconciliationNotes: All sources agree on option A (Consume 1000-1200 mg of calcium daily with meals).

questions.stem: The displayed biopsy shows extensive calcium oxalate deposition. A young patient has preserved GFR, marked hyperoxaluria, elevated urinary L-glycerate, and no enteric disease. Which diagnosis is most likely?

options.text: Primary hyperoxaluria type 1
Primary hyperoxaluria type 3
Primary hyperoxaluria type 2
Enteric hyperoxaluria

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Marked hyperoxaluria/oxalosis establishes the syndrome；在可解讀的 renal function 下，elevated urinary L-glycerate 是 PH2（GRHPR deficiency）的支持性 biochemical clue。Elevated glycolate 支持 PH1，但 normal glycolate 不能排除 PH1；最終仍以 genetic confirmation 為準。

optionAnalysisZh.A: PH1 常見 elevated glycolate，但正常 glycolate 也不能排除；本題 L-glycerate 明確指向 PH2。
optionAnalysisZh.B: PH3 與 HOGA1 pathway 有關，L-glycerate 不是其特徵性分型 marker。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；L-glycerate elevation 支持 GRHPR-deficient PH2。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 題幹排除 enteric disease，且 L-glycerate pattern 支持 primary subtype。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: PH1/PH2 pathways；glycolate 支持 PH1、L-glycerate 支持 PH2，normal glycolate 不排除 PH1。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: Image 只建立 oxalosis，不可用 crystal morphology 區分 PH1/PH2。Advanced kidney failure 會降低 urine-metabolite reliability；本題明示 preserved GFR。

questions.reconciliationNotes: All sources agree on option C (Primary hyperoxaluria type 2).

questions.stem: A patient with the displayed urine crystals continues forming stones despite high fluid intake, sodium restriction, and monitored urine alkalinization. Which medication is the best next step?

options.text: Hydrochlorothiazide
Tiopronin
Allopurinol
Acetohydroxamic acid

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Hexagonal crystals 指向 cystinuria。若 hydration、sodium restriction 與 alkalinization 已充分執行仍有 recurrent/severe stone burden，可加用 thiol drug；tiopronin 與 cystine 形成較可溶的 mixed disulfide，通常較 D-penicillamine 易耐受。

optionAnalysisZh.A: Thiazide 用於 hypercalciuric calcium stones，不是 cystine-binding therapy。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；tiopronin 是 conservative measures 失敗後的 thiol escalation。
optionAnalysisZh.C: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidoreductase，適用 uric-acid overproduction/APRT pathway，不溶解 cystine。
optionAnalysisZh.D: Acetohydroxamic acid 抑制 urease，屬 infection/struvite-stone adjunct。

authorityEvidence.note_zh: Conservative first-line；persistent/severe disease 使用 thiol agents；tiopronin mixed-disulfide mechanism。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 新診斷、負擔不高者應先 conservative therapy；本題明示已失敗。正式圖片只裁 panel B，移除 cystine/cystinuria caption。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source provided answer (B) matches both NLM responses (B). Cystine crystals in urine indicate cystinuria; when conservative management (high fluid intake, sodium restriction, urine alkalinization) fails, second-line thiol therapy with Tiopronin is the preferred next step.

questions.stem: A healthy 14-year-old has proteinuria on repeated daytime samples, with normal blood pressure, eGFR, urine sediment, and complement. Which test best evaluates suspected orthostatic proteinuria?

options.text: First-morning urine protein-to-creatinine ratio
Anti-PLA2R antibody
Immediate kidney biopsy
Twenty-four-hour urine catecholamines

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Orthostatic proteinuria 在兒童與青少年常見；upright activity 後可出現 proteinuria，但 overnight supine 後的 first-morning sample 應恢復正常。因此 first-morning UPCR 是最直接的確認步驟。若 first-morning proteinuria 持續或伴 hematuria、hypertension、low complement、edema 或 kidney dysfunction，需進一步評估。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；比較 first-morning 與 daytime protein excretion 可驗證 postural pattern。
optionAnalysisZh.B: Anti-PLA2R 用於 membranous nephropathy，並非本情境第一線檢查。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 無 red flags 時不應直接 biopsy；先做 timing-dependent urine confirmation。
optionAnalysisZh.D: Catecholamines 不評估 proteinuria 的 postural pattern。

authorityEvidence.source: Brenner 11e, Chapter 72, Diseases of the Kidney and Upper Urinary Tract in Children
authorityEvidence.note_zh: Orthostatic proteinuria 在 asymptomatic children/adolescents 常見且預後良好。

authorityEvidence.source: Brenner 11e, Chapter 23, Laboratory Assessment of Kidney Disease
authorityEvidence.note_zh: Upright sample 有 protein、first-morning void 無 protein；early-morning testing 為 diagnostic next step。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 不套用成人 proteinuria threshold；本題不給數值 cutoff，只測 first-morning confirmation。任何 persistent first-morning abnormality 都會改變 benign interpretation。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source provided answer (A) matches both NLM responses (A). First-morning urine protein-to-creatinine ratio is the standard non-invasive test to evaluate suspected orthostatic proteinuria in asymptomatic adolescents with daytime proteinuria.
